title: Universal Control V5 backend migration
human_intent: Keep the exact functional/visual behavior that emerged from the Universal Control V5 work while making its internal backend progressively modular, local-first and durable. Migration must be monotonic: parity before replacement, one subsystem at a time, no Served promotion on regression.

recovery.rule: The transcript is historical intent/evidence. Current Git/gh-pages bytes and authority records outrank transcript claims about what was eventually published.

already_decided: Exactly one Universal Control is global; child pages do not own Prometeo global navigation.
The retired per-page shell v2 stays a compatibility stub and must never mount UI.
The current V5 served payload is the executable Golden Master for observable behavior during backend extraction.
Persistent Favorites are ordered stable page_id values and stay reachable through the same control plus fullscreen Organizar páginas.
Corner Anchor is already materially integrated in current Git: semantic corner only, no pixel persistence, four corners, mirrored spatial input, Enter commit and Escape back.
Do not reimplement Corner Anchor merely because the recovered chat ended before it observed the later integration.
Backend extraction and visual/physics redesign are separate changes.
P1 compatibility facade is integrated on main and verified against the Golden Master; it did not change Served bytes or storage authority.
P2 may shadow PrometeoDB only. Legacy localStorage remains canonical read/write authority until explicit cutover gates pass.
Future persistence cutovers follow PrometeoDB additive/idempotent/rollback-safe rules and shadow parity first.
A candidate that loses a proven baseline capability is rejected rather than promoted.
write_scope: one independent worker-status object when runtime protocol requires it
must_preserve: Favorites pin/unpin, quick access, fullscreen organizer and order
Corner Anchor semantic persistence and four-corner mirroring
recording not interrupted by moving the closed puck
high_value_targets: Add a Favorites PrometeoDB shadow adapter behind the integrated compatibility boundary without changing canonical read/write ownership.
Shadow-write ordered stable page_id projections additively and non-blockingly; never make UI success depend on the shadow.
Compare legacy localStorage vs shadow DB across pin/unpin, reorder, catalog pruning, reload and offline/recovery cases.
Persist mismatch evidence and rollback knowledge without exposing private user values in public coordination.
Only after sustained parity may a separate P3 proposal request ownership cutover; P2 itself may not publish new Served bytes.
known_failures: Publishing incomplete V5 chunk sets caused boot 404s.
A truncated base64 payload caused atob invalid-character failure.
Per-page shell injection produced duplicate Prometeo controls.
Silent fallback implementations can hide backend degradation if treated as final authority.
Refactoring multiple domains at once makes regression attribution and rollback unreliable.
Using arbitrary fake ids as an online absolute browser expectation is invalid because the live catalog correctly prunes unknown ids.
Using transcript chronology as current truth can falsely classify Corner Anchor as unfinished even though later Git integrated it.
execution_frontier: Phase P2 SHADOW_PARITY on candidate/universal-control-v5-shadow-favorites-20260910. Introduce a PrometeoDB Favorites shadow adapter with zero canonical-write authority; verify parity and mismatch reporting while Served V5 and legacy localStorage remain untouched.
